svg.title: Memetic NAS Full Pipeline Diagram
svg.desc: Full flowchart of the proposed Memetic NAS algorithm: MOEA/D initialization, sub-problem loop with GA and PSO operators, simulated annealing gate, neighborhood update, stagnation restart, and evaluation archive.

g.text: Best in neighborhood under weight k

svg.text: NFE = Number of Function Evaluations · T = SA temperature · T_n = neighborhood of sub-problem n · K = number of weight vectors
